title: EDHOC c5t handshake over 1-hop TSCH (server=root node1, client=node2)

test.description: 1-hop baseline for the M1 latency-vs-hops sweep. node1 = c5t server + RPL root + TSCH coordinator; node2 = c5t client (direct neighbour, resolves root via EDHOC_CONF_SERVER_FROM_ROOT). Read the client's 'EDHOC finished' timestamp. Same multi-hop client firmware as the 2/3-hop configs so the only variable is hop count; at 1 hop the client syncs to the coordinator so the ASN-drift tolerance is a no-op.
